name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Customer Success Manager | Executive Relationships, Adoption, Retention & Expansion
summary: Strategic customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, most of it serving small and mid-sized businesses. At Birdeye I managed a reseller channel of 15-20 partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), used utilization signals to flag at-risk accounts early, and retained all but one (~94%). At Wix I launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets and drove a 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts. At Accelo I built relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational systems and adoption.

Design automated onboarding and lifecycle workflows that activate, nurture, and retain customers without manual chasing.
Guide owners through the change from manual processes to automated workflows, documenting playbooks so the process scales.
